SELECT /* com.kt.openapi.web.mypage.dao.MypageDAO.getApiRevCnt */ COUNT (*) FROM KOA_TB_REVIEW A LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC D ON (A.API_SPC_NO = CAST(D.API_SPC_NO AS VARCHAR)) WHERE (A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND (A.REVIEW_RQT_TYPE_CD = #{reviewRqtTypeCd}) AND (A.API_REVIEW_RQT_NO NOT IN (SELECT B.API_REVIEW_RQT_NO FROM KOA_TB_REVIEW_OPIN B WHERE (B.DEL_YN = 'N')))
AND (COALESCE(A.API_SPC_NO, '') != '')
AND (A.REGR = #{mbrId})
AND (1 = 2)
AND A.REVIEW_SYS_ID IN
#{item}

SELECT /* com.kt.openapi.web.mypage.dao.MypageDAO.selWriteApi */ API_SPC_NO AS "apiSpcNo", A.API_SPC_ID AS "apiSpcId", A.VER AS ver, A.API_NM AS "apiNm", COALESCE(A.API_DESC,'') AS "apiDesc", COALESCE(A.AMDR,'') AS amdr, A.AMD_DT AS "amdDt", COALESCE((SELECT MBR_NM FROM KOA_TB_MBR B WHERE A.AMDR = B.MBR_ID ),'') AS "amdrNm", TO_CHAR(A.AMD_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS "amdDtStr", A.REG_STTUS_CD AS "regSttusCd", COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS "regSttusCdNm", A.SYS_ID AS "sysId", COALESCE(S.SYS_NM,'') AS "sysIdNm" FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC A LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (A.REG_STTUS_CD = D.COMN_CD) AND (D.GROUP_CD = 'APIREG1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM S ON (S.SYS_ID = A.SYS_ID) WHERE (A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND (A.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1010') /* 작성중 */
AND (1 = 2)
AND A.AUT_ID IN
#{item}
ORDER BY A.AMD_DT DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT PSTING_ID AS "pstingId", BBS_TYPE_CD AS "bbsTypeCd", PSTING_NO AS "pstingNo", TITLE AS title, SHOW_YN AS "showYn", TO_CHAR(AMD_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS bp1date FROM KOA_TB_BBS WHERE (BBS_TYPE_CD = 'BBSTYP1020') AND (SHOW_YN = 'Y') AND (DEL_YN = 'N') AND (AMD_DT = (SELECT MAX(AMD_DT) AS MAXDT FROM KOA_TB_BBS WHERE (BBS_TYPE_CD = 'BBSTYP1020') AND (SHOW_YN = 'Y') AND (REGR = #{regr}) AND (DEL_YN = 'N'))) AND (REGR = #{regr})
SELECT COUNT(*) AS COMMCNT FROM KOA_TB_BBS_REPL WHERE (PSTING_ID = #{pstingId}) AND (DEL_YN = 'N')

SELECT QNA_ID AS "qnaId", TITLE AS title, QSTN AS qstn, ANS AS ans, QNA_STTUS_CD AS "qnaSttusCd", SHOW_YN AS "showYn", TO_CHAR(AMD_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS qnaDate FROM KOA_TB_QNA WHERE (SHOW_YN = 'Y') AND (REGR = #{regr}) AND (AMD_DT IN (SELECT MAX(AMD_DT) AS AMDDT FROM KOA_TB_QNA WHERE (SHOW_YN = 'Y') AND (REGR = #{regr})))

SELECT TA.AUT_ID AS "autId", TA.AUT_NM AS "autNm", TA.SYS_ID AS "sysId", COALESCE(S.SYS_NM,'') AS "sysNm", AM.AUT_STTUS_CD AS "autSttusCd", AM.AUT_APV_DT AS "autApvDt", AM.AUT_APVR AS "autApvr" FROM KOA_TB_AUT TA JOIN KOA_TB_AUT_MPPG AM ON (TA.AUT_ID = AM.AUT_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM S ON (S.SYS_ID = TA.SYS_ID) WHERE (AM.MBR_ID = #{mbrId}) AND (TA.USE_YN = 'Y') AND (AM.AUT_STTUS_CD = 'MBRAUT1020') AND (AM.USE_PERD_ST_DT <= NOW()) AND (AM.USE_PERD_FNS_DT >= NOW()) ORDER BY AM.AMD_DT DESC

SELECT TA.AUT_ID AS "autId", TA.AUT_NM AS "autNm", TA.SYS_ID AS "sysId", COALESCE(S.SYS_NM,'') AS "sysNm", AM.AUT_STTUS_CD AS "autSttusCd", AM.AUT_APY_DT AS "autApyDt", AM.AUT_APV_DT AS "autApvDt", AM.AUT_APVR AS "autApvr" FROM KOA_TB_AUT TA JOIN KOA_TB_AUT_MPPG AM ON (TA.AUT_ID = AM.AUT_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM S ON (S.SYS_ID = TA.SYS_ID) WHERE (AM.MBR_ID = #{mbrId}) AND (TA.USE_YN = 'Y') AND (AM.AUT_STTUS_CD != 'MBRAUT1020') AND (AM.USE_PERD_ST_DT <= NOW()) AND (AM.USE_PERD_FNS_DT >= NOW()) ORDER BY AM.AMD_DT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KOA_TB_AUT_MPPG WHERE (AUT_ID = #{autId}) AND (MBR_ID = #{mbrId}) AND ((AUT_STTUS_CD = 'MBRAUT1010') OR (AUT_STTUS_CD = 'MBRAUT1020')) AND (USE_PERD_ST_DT <= NOW()) AND (USE_PERD_FNS_DT >= NOW())
SELECT SYS_ID AS "sysId", SYS_NM AS "sysNm" FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM ORDER BY SYS_NM ASC

SELECT AUT_ID AS "autId", AUT_NM AS "autNm", SYS_ID AS "sysId" FROM KOA_TB_AUT WHERE (USE_YN = 'Y')
AND (SYS_ID = #{sysId})
ORDER BY AUT_NM ASC

SELECT AUT_ID AS "autId", AUT_STTUS_CD AS "autSttusCd", AUT_APV_RCESS_SBST AS "autApvRcessSbst" FROM KOA_TB_AUT_MPPG WHERE (MBR_ID = #{mbrId}) AND (AUT_ID = #{autId}) AND (AUT_STTUS_CD = #{autSttusCd})
